title: Write about Your Favorite Season
prompts: 2. How do you feel when it arrives?
3. What do you like about it?
4. What is your favorite thing to do in it? Why?
model: I like spring best. Because it's sunny and warm. I feel happy because a lot of flowers are blooming with the different colors, and everyone can feel amazing smell in the air. Sometimes it's windy. I can fly kites with my family. It is a great season. When spring comes, the trees turn green and the flowers start to grow. So spring is my favorite season because I can see nice flowers.
